title: Nahum Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Nahum 1: a jealous God who avenges, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and good news on the mountains.

questions.text: Which city is this revelation about?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:1 calls this a revelation about Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

questions.text: What is Nahum called in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:1 names the book as the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

questions.text: Where does verse 3 say Yahweh has his way?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:3 says Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

answers.text: In the temple and in the city
In the whirlwind and in the storm
In the sea and in the rivers
On the hills and in the valleys

questions.text: Besides Bashan and Carmel, what else languishes?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:4 says Bashan languishes, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languishes.

questions.text: What do the mountains do before him, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:5 says the mountains quake before him and the hills melt away.

questions.text: What is his wrath poured out like?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:6 says his wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

questions.text: What is Yahweh called in the day of trouble?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:7 says Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and he knows those who take refuge in him.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will break off from you in verse 13?
questions.explanation: In Nahum 1:13 Yahweh says he will break his yoke from off you and burst your bonds apart.

questions.text: What will Yahweh cut off out of the house of your gods?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:14 says Yahweh will cut off the engraved image and the molten image out of the house of your gods.

answers.text: The engraved image and the molten image
The altars and the high places
The silver and the gold vessels

questions.text: What is Judah told to do in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Nahum 1:15 tells Judah to keep its feasts and perform its vows, because the wicked one will no more pass through.

answers.text: Keep its feasts and perform its vows
